panels.title: Total Instances
panels.description: Total number of rocm-ernic server instances configured (manager + workers).

panels.title: Running Instances
panels.description: How many server instances have a running process. A drop means a crash or restart.

panels.title: Attached VMs
panels.description: Number of QEMU VMs currently attached to server instances via vfio-user.

panels.title: Total FLR Resets
panels.description: Function Level Resets during the selected time range. FLRs occur when a VM reboots or the guest driver reloads.

panels.title: Total QPs
panels.description: Total active Queue Pairs across all instances. Rises during RDMA tests, drops on teardown.

panels.title: GPU Passthrough VMs
panels.description: VMs with GPU passthrough enabled via vfio-pci. Shows how many VMs have direct GPU access.

panels.title: Server Details
panels.description: Per-server instance details: role (manager/worker), MAC address, process liveness, and uptime.

panels.title: VM Details
panels.description: Per-VM details: name, attachment status, uptime, and GPU passthrough state.

panels.title: IP Traffic Rate
panels.description: IP/Ethernet byte rate (TX and RX) per server instance. This is the emulated NIC data plane traffic between VMs.

panels.title: RDMA Traffic Rate
panels.description: RDMA byte rate (TX and RX) per server instance. Combines Send/Recv and Read/Write operations.

panels.title: RDMA vs IP Traffic (Total Bytes)
panels.description: Comparison of total RDMA bytes vs total IP/Ethernet bytes across all instances.

panels.title: Per-Server Traffic Totals
panels.description: Cumulative byte totals for IP and RDMA traffic per server instance.

panels.title: RDMA Send / Recv Rate
panels.description: RDMA Send and Receive byte rates per instance. Send/Recv are two-sided operations where both sides post work requests.

panels.title: RDMA Read / Write Rate
panels.description: RDMA Read and Write byte rates per instance. These are one-sided operations initiated by one side only.

panels.title: Per-QP Traffic
panels.description: Per-QP (Queue Pair) traffic breakdown showing bytes sent, received, read, and written for each active QP.

panels.title: FLR Reset Count
panels.description: Cumulative FLR reset count per instance over time. Each reset reinitializes the emulated RDMA device.

panels.title: Commands Rate
panels.description: Rate of PVRDMA commands processed per instance (create QP, register MR, etc.).

panels.title: Interrupts Rate
panels.description: Rate of interrupts delivered to VMs per instance. Interrupts notify the guest of completion events.

panels.title: MMIO Read / Write Rate
panels.description: Rate of MMIO register reads and writes per instance. MMIO is how the guest driver communicates with the emulated device.

panels.title: Stats Write Count
panels.description: Rate of stats file writes by the server. Used to monitor the exporter's data freshness.

panels.title: VM CPU Utilization
panels.description: Guest VM CPU utilization from node-exporter. Shows the fraction of CPU time not spent idle.

panels.title: VM Memory Usage
panels.description: Guest VM memory usage from node-exporter. 'Used' = MemTotal - MemAvailable.

panels.title: VM rocm-ernic0 TCP/IP Rate
panels.description: Byte rate on the emulated rocm-ernic0 NIC inside the VM. This carries RDMA data exchange and IP traffic between VMs.

panels.title: VM Management TCP/IP Rate (enp0s2)
panels.description: Byte rate on the virtio management NIC (enp0s2) inside the VM. This carries SSH, apt, and other management traffic.

panels.title: VM RDMA Port Data Rate
panels.description: RDMA port data rate from the in-VM rdma_exporter. Reads sysfs counters exposed by the kernel driver via process_mad PMA.

panels.title: VM RDMA Packet Rate
panels.description: RDMA packet rate from the in-VM rdma_exporter. Shows packets sent and received on the RDMA port.

panels.title: VM Disk I/O Rate (vda)
panels.description: Disk read and write byte rate for the virtio root disk (vda) inside each VM. Sourced from node-exporter.

panels.title: GPU Temperature
panels.description: GPU edge and memory temperatures from the AMD Device Metrics Exporter inside each VM.

panels.title: GPU Utilization
panels.description: GPU graphics engine (GFX) and memory controller (UMC) activity percentage from the AMD Device Metrics Exporter.

panels.title: GPU Power
panels.description: GPU power usage in watts from the AMD Device Metrics Exporter. Note: package power may not be available in guest VMs.

panels.title: GPU Clock & PCIe Bandwidth
panels.description: GPU clock speed (MHz) and PCIe bandwidth (Mb/s) from the AMD Device Metrics Exporter.
